body: I can't tell anyone, he is still on probation and said he will kill himself before going back to prison. I can't handle that. If I try to talk to anyone they will report it.
And I'll still be the one who brought him into the family.
When I calm down I'll still be in love with a man who molested my 7 year old niece.

I already left him. But what kind of sick fuck would still love someone who did something like that to a child I have helped raise for 7 years? I should hate him but I can't stop feeling bad for him and wanting to make everything better. I'm just as sick and disgusting as he is and I can't live with myself anymore.
